context: web site scan exited 1 with EMPTY_RESULT because the site answered HTTP 403 to robots.txt and /sitemap.xml: it blocks the client even with a browser --user-agent, so the User-Agent is not the cause. The user has a Bright Data Web Unlocker zone (an unblocker that re-signs TLS) and its CA file. site scan --proxy needs Node.js 24.14+ or 25.4+ and exits 2 UNSUPPORTED on Node 22. The proxy URL carries the password, so it belongs in WEB_PROXY, not on the command line. Judge answer.md.

checklist.name: node_version
checklist.description: Says Node.js 22.14 is too old for the proxy (site scan exits 2 UNSUPPORTED) and has the user upgrade to Node.js 24.14+ or 25.4+ first.

checklist.name: credentials_env
checklist.description: Puts the proxy URL with the zone user and password in the WEB_PROXY environment variable (e.g. `export WEB_PROXY='http://<zone user>:<password>@…'`) instead of passing it with --proxy on the command line, and does not ask for the password itself.

checklist.name: proxy_ca
checklist.description: Adds `--proxy-ca ~/certs/brightdata-ca.pem` to the web site scan command, and does not turn certificate checks off with --insecure (the vendor publishes a CA).

checklist.name: scan_command
checklist.description: Uses the web CLI's own `web site scan https://www.alpine-gear.test` (not curl loops or a hand-written crawler).

checklist.name: timeout
checklist.description: Raises --timeout to 60000 ms or more, since an unblocker can take longer than the 10 s default.
